prerequisites: P2-30 preparation evidence and exact artifacts verified
Explicit owner authorization recorded in this contract
Dedicated task-stage training command implemented, tested by repository unit coverage, and reviewed; generic pilot/runner/resume remain forbidden

baseStage.weightsOrigin: Fresh random Plex initialization -> P2-29 scratch Web pretraining -> weights-only P2-30 task stage

training.timeLimitPolicy: Stop before the next optimizer update when the run deadline is reached; save/report completed updates only.

evaluation.checkpointSelection: Report fixed step-100 endpoint or early-stop endpoint; do not select the lowest-validation checkpoint

development.runAt: final completed step only; existing stage-zero baseline retained

implementationRequirements: Verify exact contract and checkpoint hashes before allocating outputs
Reject any stageTransitionRecord with a different base, tokenizer, task dataset or step
Keep original initialization provenance and propagate stage transition unchanged into checkpoints
Maintain task-only step/token accounting and fresh sampler
Fresh output directory; no implicit resume or extension
Reverify saved model and checkpoint identities before final evaluation

rationale.sampler: All records fit comfortably (train 89-145, validation 92-131 tokens including EOS). Complete records preserve prompt/answer alignment at position zero and EOS; the previous complete-record arm showed 3/156 exact seen answers versus 0/156 for packed arms. This is a historical comparison, not proof of held-out improvement.
rationale.objective: Ordinary next-token loss with answer weight 1; historical 4x weighting did not improve complete development tasks. No objective, curriculum, architecture or learning-rate-schedule sweep.
rationale.historicalComparator: docs/PHASE-2-COMPLETE-RECORD-COMPARISON.md: 100 updates, ordinary loss, complete-record-v1, same task split, micro-batch 1, accumulation 16, seed and AdamW settings.
rationale.comparisonLimit: Historical tokenizer was 1509 entries and is not reused. The frozen Web tokenizer and learned starting weights differ, and real target positions are 181849 versus historical 149760. This cannot isolate a pure causal pretraining effect or support direct cross-tokenizer loss comparisons.

continuationRule: Stop after the bounded run. No resume or automatic continuation is authorized. Owner reviews artifact identities, learning behavior and development results before any further optimizer update.
command: uv run --project training --no-sync python -m plex_training.cli task-finetune-run --checkpoint training/artifacts/task-finetune/p2-30-stage0/stage-checkpoint.pt --bundle-dir training/artifacts/task-finetune/p2-30-request-v3-16k --output-dir task-finetune/p2-30-first-run
